question: Is the 2018 empanelment of IT consultants still valid?
gold_answer: No. It expired 19-03-2023, was extended to 19-09-2023 (24-04-2023), and was replaced by a new empanelment from 20-09-2023 to 19-09-2028 (05-10-2023)

product.answer: The 2018 empanelment is no longer valid because the 2023 GR (dated 05-10-2023) states it expired on 19th September 2023 and replaced it with a new 5-year empanelment from 20th September 2023 to 19th September 2028. However, the 2023 circular (dated 24-04-2023) had previously extended the 2018 empanelment for 6 months until 19th September 2023 or till finalization of new empanelment, whichever is earlier.
